title: Cream Knit & Brown Pleated Skirt
prompt: An original young woman with long, dark wavy hair and a soft smile stands on a warm-toned street. She wears a cream knit top with a high neck and fitted sleeves, paired with a brown pleated midi skirt with a wide waistband. A pendant necklace sits at her throat, and she carries a taupe leather tote at her side. Warm, natural light, a palette of cream, chocolate, and taupe. Polished and cozy, in the style of an autumn street-style look book.
workingNotes:
- The pleated skirt and cream top create a clean color contrast.
- Describe the tote as 'structured leather' for a more polished look.
tryThis: Try this: Describe the tote as structured leather.
